page.overview:
Who is Gecko Moria?

Gecko Moria is the captain of the Thriller Bark Pirates and a former member of the Seven Warlords of the Sea who resides on Thriller Bark, the largest ship in the world. His bounty is 320,000,000, which was frozen until he lost his Warlord position.

Born in the West Blue, Moria was raised by the people of Ringo in Wano Country and given the name Kouzuki Moria. He set out to sea as captain of the Gecko Pirates, but returned to Wano to battle Kaidou, resulting in the extermination of his crew. This traumatic event led Moria to seek power through an army of zombies, constructed by his subordinate, Dr. Hogback. To that end he stole the shadows of several beings with his Kage Kage no Mi powers, including Brook and several members of the Straw Hat Pirates, bringing him into conflict with them.

His zombie army was ultimately destroyed and the captured shadows set free after his defeat by the Straw Hats, but he retained his position as a Warlord. He took part in the Summit War of Marineford, but afterwards was stripped of his title with the World Government unsuccessfully attempting to kill him. Two years after the war, Moria came into conflict with the Blackbeard Pirates. He was also cloned by Vegapunk as one of the Seraphim to replace the Warlords.

He is the main antagonist of the Thriller Bark Saga and a major antagonist in the Marineford Arc.
